Ensure you: - **Do not intrude** on their privacy unless they invite you. - **Respect their culture and beliefs** (e.g., if they are Muslim, avoid serving non-halal food; if they are not, do not impose your religion). - **Communicate respectfully**—ask if they have any dietary restrictions or preferences. 5. **Is It Right or Wrong?
